summary: Hub `/etc/pulp/certs/pulp_webserver.key` is the web TLS key and `database_fields.symmetric.key` encrypts sensitive hub DB fields (lose it and they can't be read). Event-Driven Ansible keeps `SECRET_KEY`, `settings.yaml` (DB and Redis passwords, gateway sync key) and `server.cert` under `/etc/ansible-automation-platform/eda/`.
questions: What is database_fields.symmetric.key in automation hub?
Where is the EDA controller SECRET_KEY?
Where is the Event-Driven Ansible database password stored?
What happens if the hub symmetric key is lost?

answer_card.title: Hub and EDA secret files (RPM)
answer_card.answer_md:
| File | Holds |
|---|---|
| `/etc/pulp/settings.py` | Hub DB password, Django secret key |
| `/etc/pulp/certs/database_fields.symmetric.key` | Encrypts hub DB fields. Lose it and they're unreadable |
| `/etc/pulp/certs/pulp_webserver.crt` / `.key` | Hub web TLS |
| `/etc/ansible-automation-platform/eda/SECRET_KEY` | Encrypts EDA DB fields |
| `/etc/ansible-automation-platform/eda/settings.yaml` | EDA DB and Redis passwords, gateway sync key |
| `/etc/ansible-automation-platform/eda/server.cert` / `.key` | EDA web TLS |
